messages:
anya_sales: Looping everyone in for Silverpine Health's RFI — three asks: (1) 4-week POC plan + sample cost, (2) KMS/HSM options with attestation artifacts, (3) SLA/latency guarantees for Dedicated pools. I attached a draft capability matrix and asked for a short summary for their security team.

drew_se: 4-week POC sounds good. Proposed cadence: week0 prep, week1 data + onboarding, week2 baseline evals, week3 scale tests, week4 signoff. Need sample payloads and p95/p99 targets to size cluster.

elliot_poc: Customer target: p99 <= 120ms for 400-token prompts, steady 50 req/s, burst to 300/s. They will provide 2k sample queries and some labeled scores. KMS requirement: customer-managed keys, preference for cloud-HSM with FIPS 140-2.

nora_security: We support BYOK via cloud KMS for Hosted; Private supports HSM. We can provide SOC2 Type II report excerpt, KMS access logs, and an HSM attestation checklist. For Private + HSM we'll need an SOW; estimate 3-4 weeks of integration engineering.

anya_sales: Pricing question: what's the estimated POC cost for 4 weeks on Dedicated sized for those perf targets (2x A100 equiv)? Also what are overage rules and fallback behavior?

tomas_product: Ballpark POC cost: $16k-20k depending on run hours and storage. Dedicated reserved unit-rate equates to ~ $0.0005 / 1k tokens effective. Hosted list is $0.00085 / 1k tokens. Overages billed at 1.5x reserved rate; automated fallback to Hosted if fallback enabled. No hard throttles unless account hits global limits. We'll add a short pricing table in the RFI reply.

drew_se: Tech config recommendation: model: mix of opt-weighted open model (e.g., mix-7b for embeddings, falcon-40b-q4 for gen) but for low-latency gen use quantized Falcon 180B q4 if they accept memory footprint. Runtime sample: ```
model: falcon-180b-q4
batching: auto
max_seq: 512
kv_cache: true
quant_profile: q4_8
routing:
  primary: dedicated
  fallback: hosted
```

anya_sales: Uploaded draft capability matrix + attestation docs: https://drive.redwood/silverpine/rfi-capmat.xlsx and https://drive.redwood/silverpine/security-pack.zip

nora_security: :white_check_mark: I'll produce a 1-pager for HSM attestation and a checklist for KMS audit logs. Two items to flag for the customer: (1) separation-of-privileges for key ops, (2) timeline for HSM onboarding if Private deployment chosen.

elliot_poc: Quick Q on throttling behavior during bursts: if burst > buffer and fallback disabled, do we queue or error?

tomas_product: By default we queue up to configurable queue depth and then return 429s. Recommend enabling Hosted fallback for critical paths to avoid 429s during overload. We'll document defaults in the RFI.

anya_sales: Action items: Drew -> POC runbook + perf targets + tooling snippets by Wed EOD. Nora -> HSM attestation + SOC excerpt by Thu. Tomas -> pricing table and overage policy. I'll consolidate and send RFI response Friday morning. cc @upload-bot to attach final docs.

upload-bot: Documents uploaded: silverpine-rfi-capmat.xlsx (internal link)

drew_se: Runbook draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/silverpine/runbook.md 
Includes load-generator command and telemetry hooks. Example load: `hey loadgen --qps 100 --payload sample.json --endpoint https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate`

anya_sales: Thanks everyone. Silverpine, we'll send the consolidated RFI by Friday 09:00 PT. If you want a sync call tomorrow for payload validation, we have a 30m slot at 11:00am PT available.

elliot_poc: 11:00 works, thanks.

anya_sales: Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
